arguments.cmd:
J=$(find /usr/share /usr/lib/python3* -name '*.jpg' -o -name '*.jpeg' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "JPEG found: $J"
if [ -n "$J" ]; then cp "$J" ../input/stego.jpg; else
  python3 -c "
from PIL import Image; import random
im=Image.new('RGB',(320,240))
im.putdata([(random.randrange(256),random.randrange(256),random.randrange(256)) for _ in range(320*240)])
im.save('../input/stego.jpg',quality=95)
print('generated jpeg')
" 2>&1
fi
ls -la ../input/stego.jpg
printf 'SECRET-OK-20261015\n' > /tmp/secret.txt
steghide embed -cf ../input/stego.jpg -ef /tmp/secret.txt -p qwbpass -f 2>&1
echo "steghide rc=$?"
sha256sum ../input/stego.jpg
steghide info ../input/stego.jpg -p qwbpass 2>&1 | head -8
